 Warm temps with highs in 50s, 60s to continue
 By Tom Rivers, Editor Posted 18 November 2026 at 4:49 pm 
 Kimberly Stawicki took this photo this morning of geese on a misty Erie Canal between Medina and Middleport.
 The unseasonably warm weather will continue for the next several days with high temperatures in the 50s and 60s.
 The National Weather Service in Buffalo is forecasting a sunny Thursday with a high of 60 in Orleans County, followed by a sunny Friday with a high of 58.
 The weekend includes a sunny Saturday with a high near 64, followed by a sunny Sunday with another high near 64.
 It gets cooler on Monday with a high near 49 followed by a high of 38 on Tuesday, according to the NWS.
